4 buyers report being sold motorcycles with forged registration transfer papers by a man identifying himself as a used-vehicle dealer.

Complainant took a small loan via a mobile app, was charged hidden fees far exceeding the loan, and received threatening calls to his contacts.

Firm 'CoastalGrow Investments' collected deposits promising 5% monthly returns from an estimated 60+ investors before its office shut and operators became unreachable.
Bank reports a skimming device found on an ATM; 12 customers report unauthorized withdrawals totaling over Rs 6 lakh.
Similar skimming pattern identified at a Bengaluru ATM, same bank's device model; 8 customers affected.
Forest range officer discovers 6 sandalwood trees felled overnight inside the reserve boundary; drag marks lead to an unmanned forest road exit.
Group clash outside a college gate involving 6+ young men, resulting in 2 hospitalized with head injuries; both sides claim the other started it.
